name: dd-quoting-agent
description: For sales reps: an autonomous quoting colleague. It plans the whole job (new quotes, multi-site ramps, renewals, upgrades, fitting a budget, fixing expiring quotes), prices every step with the DD CPQ engine, asks once, runs it, checks the cart and reports. Shortcuts: /quote, /scenario, /fit, /amend, /renew, /golive, /sweep, /prep, /my-day, /renewals, /approvals, /setup.
